event.title: Senate Leaders Agree on Short-Term Spending Bill to Prevent Government Shutdown
event.canonical_title: Senate Leaders Agree on Short-Term Spending Bill to Prevent Government Shutdown
event.summary: Senate leaders have reached a funding agreement aimed at preventing a government shutdown during the upcoming midterm elections. The short-term spending bill is expected to be voted on before the Senate's August recess, allowing lawmakers to focus on their reelection campaigns. This deal comes amid tensions with the White House regarding science funding and other budgetary issues.

timeline.title: Senate Approves Short-Term Funding Bill to Avert Government Shutdown Ahead of Midterms
timeline.summary: The Senate voted 90-6 to pass a short-term funding bill aimed at preventing a government shutdown before the midterm elections. The measure will keep federal agencies funded until December 11 and is now headed to the House for consideration. This action comes as Congress prepares for a five-week recess.
key_facts: Bill aims to prevent government shutdown before midterms
